title: Subscription · audio
blurb: The same bargain for ears: a credit or a catalogue each month, and the book is only yours while you pay.

items.d: One credit a month plus a members' sale, the largest audiobook catalogue.
The same model, with the money going to an independent bookshop you choose.
Audiobooks inside a music subscription, with a monthly hour allowance.
Unlimited reading and listening for one price, no credits.
Credits and a rotating free selection, with apps on every platform.
Fifteen-minute summaries, useful as an index and useless as a substitute.
